contradictions.claim_a: The requested source directory contains Flutter libraries to move.
contradictions.claim_b: The repository identifies itself as templates, scripts, and references with no runnable application or canonical runtime package.
contradictions.resolution: Treat hybrid-mobile-architecture-src as MIT reference-only; do not manufacture a runtime migration from templates.

contradictions.claim_a: The user explicitly requested that the KnowMe Flutter libraries move into this monorepo.
contradictions.claim_b: The KnowMe repository has no tracked root or package license, while the destination release contract requires MIT and blocks unlicensed source.
contradictions.strategy: scope authority plus explicit destination record
contradictions.resolution: Record the user's owner-directed move as source authority before copying, preserve Travis James/KnowMe attribution, apply the destination MIT license explicitly, and retain a path/commit manifest. This is a project authorization record, not general legal advice.

contradictions.claim_a: A history-preserving import should retain original commit identifiers.
contradictions.claim_b: Path filtering and renaming necessarily rewrites commit hashes.
contradictions.strategy: Git object model and official filter-repo documentation
contradictions.resolution: Preserve authors, dates, messages, file evolution, and an original-to-filtered commit map; do not claim SHA identity after rewriting.

contradictions.claim_a: Every dependency should be changed to its highest version immediately.
contradictions.claim_b: Riverpod, Freezed, analyzer, and generators form a compatibility matrix; Riverpod 3 also changes retries and notifier APIs.
contradictions.strategy: official migration guide plus resolver evidence
contradictions.resolution: Target the newest mutually resolvable stable versions, prove code generation/analyze/tests, and record justified pins rather than equating numeric latest with compatibility.
